column1: # names_gpio_ir.tsv - functions identified by the GPIO / IR pass (#93), JXC 4K Dahua firmware, 8051:BE:16:default

# Format: address<TAB>name<TAB>type<TAB>comment<TAB>status (as ghidra_names_bank6.tsv); the bank is the first token of the comment ([bank N]); bank-0 entries are in the common-area or bank-0-private code
# Not merged into ghidra_names_bank*.tsv: the names merge needs one file per bank; copy rows over when applying.

column4: [bank 1] 14-case jump table at 8ab5, arg = SDK EnumPowerAction (0 OFF_TO_NORMAL .. 13 FAKE_OFF_TO_NORMAL); per action: ScalerPowerIsolation (d8eb), clock select (acd8), ScalerPinshareConfig (0723), UserInterfacePowerSwitch (d3ac); handler bodies at 8adf-8bb4 are not disassembled by Ghidra (read from bank1.bin)
[bank 1] SDK UserInterfacePowerSwitch: action 0/2 LED on; 3 LED off + panel down; 6 LED off + NVRAM; 7 LED saving + panel down; 8 LED off + panel down + NVRAM off; cd09 = NVRAM set, fe09 = save
[bank 1] switch on SDK EnumLedIndication 0..13: 0,1,2,4 -> (P3.5,P3.6)=(1,0); 3,5 -> (0,1); 6,13 -> (0,0); 7 -> P3.5=1; 8 -> P3.6=1; two-colour power LED
[bank 0] banked-call trampoline to UserInterfaceKeyPadLedControl; callers 0:d959 (ACTIVE), 0:d973 (SEARCH, NOSUPPORT)
[bank 0] banked-call trampoline to ScalerPinshareConfig (6:5d88); only caller 1:8aa1 handlers (8b2c, 8b5c, 8bde)
[bank 6] SDK ScalerPinshareConfig(power status): 2 NORMAL -> P9.7,PA.0,P8.5,P8.4 = 1; 3 SAVING and 1 OFF -> 0; 0 AC_ON -> flash drive only (board macros PCB_GPIO_SETTING_POWER_*)
[bank 1] Dahua addition inside ScalerPowerIsolation (adb1): arg 0 = P8.4 high, 10 ms, P8.5 high, 10 ms (only if VCCKOFF_CONTROL0 bit4 or GA_POWER_CTRL bit1); arg 1 = P8.5 low, P8.4 low, 200 ms
[bank 1] P9.7, PA.0, P8.5, P8.4 = 1; called from d7ab when isolation flag e23b bit0 is set (group A recover)
[bank 1] for each flag bit of e23b: clear and run the group recover (f188, fed6, fe2c DPTx1 initial, fed7, fe32); called in the to-normal actions
[bank 1] returns g_stPowerInfo high nibble (e23a >> 4) = current power status, 2 = NORMAL (bank 5 has an unrelated function at e49f)
[bank 1] returns e22e & 0x1F = mode state (SDK EnumModeStatus: 0 INITIAL, 1 SEARCH, 2 DISPLAY_SETTING, 3 ACTIVE, 4 NOSUPPORT, 5 NOSIGNAL, 6 POWER_SAVING, 7 POWER_OFF); trampoline 0:0f51
[bank 1] bit param (0x20.4) inverted; P7.4 = !bMute when f69b() is 3 (BOTH) or 1 (SPEAKER), else 0; caller 3:f8e5 via thunk 0:055b
[bank 1] reads P4.5: low -> 1 (SPEAKER), high -> 2 (HEADPHONE)

[bank 0] switch on SysModeGetModeState (jump table d8d7): LED calls on mode-state change (SEARCH 1, ACTIVE 3, NOSUPPORT 4), tail calls osd_keycode_to_event_idx; Ghidra has no function here (code after d8c4 not disassembled)
[bank 0] R6:R7 = XDATA E20A:E20B = last non-power IR code word (command, ~command)
[bank 0] R6:R7 = XDATA E14E:E14F = usOsdState, C cleared

[bank 0] IR code word E20A:E20B -> e151 key message 0..3 per usOsdState range, or e4dc(item) / dd7c page when the OSD is closed; table in docs/reversing/dahua-fw/gpio-ir.md s.6.3 (existing name osd_keycode_to_event_idx)
[bank 0] id < 0x4F: value-adjust page of OSD item id (UP/DOWN hot-key slots e06c/e06b and IR direct keys call it); meaning of the ids not decoded

[bank 6] SDK RTDIRKeyScan: zero-init DBB4[8] from code 0xFF:3067 (all zero), ScalerIRHWModeGetData, accept if DBB6 == ~DBB7, 16-bit switch on DBB4:DBB5 (Keil helper 163d): 0xB946 -> return 1 (POWER mask); else store E20A:E20B, return 0; no frame clears E20A:E20B
[bank 5] ScalerIRHWModeDecoder(table 5:2B0E, bank 5) via thunk 0:0eeb; table is byte-identical to SDK IRRemote/NEC_DTV328.h; caller 1:e32b via thunk 0:0def
[bank 0] banked-call trampoline to ScalerIRHWModeDecoder
[bank 0] banked-call trampoline to ScalerIRHWModeInitial
[bank 0] banked-call trampoline to ScalerIRHWModeClockSel; callers 1:ad68 (arg 1 = power-saving clock IOSC) and 1:ad9d (XTAL) in 1:acd8
[bank 1] arg 1 = power-saving clock: ScalerGlobalSystemClkSel(1) and IR ClockSel(1); arg 0 / 2 = normal (XTAL)
[bank 5] 32-byte IR protocol table: 6D 1A 1A 50 00 03 17 36 FF 7D | 13 9F 00 00 00 DF | 77 1E 1E 64 00 00 1F 3E | 00 x8 (= SDK NEC_DTV328)
[bank 6] 8 bytes 0x00 = zero initialiser of the local IR buffer in RTDIRKeyScan (not a code table)
